name: Dungeon Dominator
storyline:
Dungeon Dominator is a dungeon management strategy in dark fantasy, where you must reclaim your title of god in a world that has dared to forget you.

Now you are Illazar. Once a fearsome lord, banished to the Sphere of Oblivion, and now again summoned by desperate mortals. And while the kingdoms are mired in senseless wars, one of the rulers has obtained a mysterious artifact, threatening all that lives. The world is on the brink of annihilation. And only you, the ancient evil, can bring order here. In your own way.
summary: Build and expand your own warm, cozy dungeon where your minions live miserable lives and do their evil things. Take part in thrilling battles against humans, angels, and powerful bosses, defending your domain. Conquer the world by commanding an army with a wave of your hand!
